title: myrabbit review output
description: One merged myrabbit review of one PR at one head SHA (the run document of design.md §5.2, plus the optional design-v2 §8 fields context, tools, checks, effort, risk, labels, related, reviewers and proposed_learnings, which are serialised only when non-empty). Emitted by the merge step; scored by eval/scripts/score.ts. Verdict rule: REQUEST_CHANGES iff some finding has blocking=true and a status other than addressed/superseded/dismissed.

prompt_version.description: Identifier of the reviewer prompt set, e.g. p1.

merge_version.description: Identifier of the merge/dedupe logic, e.g. m1.

sources.description: Engines that contributed to this run.

case_id.description: Eval case id when produced by the eval harness.

context.$comment: design-v2 §3.2. Present only when the context pack ran.

symbols.description: Changed symbols included in the pack.

usages.description: Definition/usage snippets included in the pack.

resolver.description: How usages were found, e.g. "tree-sitter" or "tree-sitter+ts".

dropped.description: Symbols left out by the budget. Truncation is not incomplete coverage.

tools.$comment: design-v2 §7.4. Present only when static analysis ran.

status.description: unverified = sha256 mismatch against tools.lock (§7.2); the tool did not run. A non-ok gitleaks run is a blocking coverage item.

files.description: Changed files staged for this tool.

hits.description: Normalised hits on added/context lines, capped at 50 (§7.4 step 1).

message.description: Tool message, redacted. For gitleaks never the matched value (§7.5).

confirmed.description: true when some engine reported it as a finding with rule = <tool>:<rule>.

checks.$comment: design-v2 §5. Combined (damped, §5.2) status per configured check.

name.description: title, description, docstrings, linked_issues, or a custom check name.

mode.description: Checks in mode off are not run and not listed.

effort.$comment: design-v2 §4.1. The higher engine score with its minutes; never affects the verdict.

risk.$comment: design-v2 §4.2. Computed, never model-set. APPROVE implies risk <= low.

labels.$comment: design-v2 §4.5. Suggested only, never applied; names come from the base config list.

related.$comment: design-v2 §4.6. Only candidate numbers survive; at most 10 issues + 10 PRs.

reviewers.$comment: design-v2 §4.7. Computed from the base SHA; never requested.

proposed_learnings.$comment: design-v2 §6.2. At most 3 per run; rendered as a snippet, never written by myrabbit.

paths.description: Globs for the `paths:` line; empty = repo-wide.

fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the finding whose thread produced the proposal.

allOf.$comment: path and line are required unless the finding is synthetic (design §7.5 coverage finding).

line.description: Anchor line on the side given by `side`.

end_line.description: Range end, >= line; null or absent = single line.

side.description: Diff side of `line`. Absent = RIGHT. The CodeRabbit gold is all RIGHT.

suggestion.description: Replacement text for lines line..end_line (RIGHT side only); rendered as a ```suggestion block.

sources.description: Engine(s) that raised this finding before merge.

fingerprint.description: Stable id for incremental dedupe (design §7.1). Eval uses it only to key adjudication labels across runs.

outside_diff.description: true when the finding does not anchor to the diff; it renders in the body only.

status.description: Thread lifecycle. Absent = new. addressed/superseded/dismissed findings are history: they never count toward the verdict and are not scored.

rule.description: What the finding enforces: "<tool>:<rule>" (static analysis, §7.4), "learning:<title>" (§6.1) or the engine's quoted style-guide rule.

synthetic.description: true for findings the pipeline adds itself (design §7.5 coverage incomplete). path/line become optional; synthetic findings count toward the verdict but not toward recall or precision.
